assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology.
CPT code 93229 was used for the service.
The study aims to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The study aims to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management given the high risk of thromboembolic complications.
